title: Running a Team Without Running Yourself Down
description: Placeholder module (content-agnostic proof). Replaced when authored material lands.

objectives.label: Make the plan visible to everyone
Ask for help before the deadline

blocks.text: A plan that lives only in your head cannot be helped with. Write down who does what and by when, in the place your team already checks.

slides.title: Which plan can a team use?

blocks.question: Which version of the plan can your team actually use?

options.label: A shared list with names and dates
A plan you remember and explain when asked
A rough feeling about who is busy

blocks.explanation: Names and dates let anyone spot a gap and offer help. A plan in your head only works while you are in the room.

blocks.title: Punchline
blocks.text: Asking for help on Monday is planning. Asking on Friday is an emergency.
